_comment: Add / remove sources freely. This file is the whole control panel. Three kinds of source are supported:

_how_to_add.youtube: type: 'youtube'. Give EITHER a 'channelId' (starts with UC...) OR a 'handle'/'url' (e.g. '@MeidasTouch' or the channel URL). The server resolves handles to channel IDs automatically. No API key needed.
_how_to_add.podcast: type: 'podcast'. Give EITHER a direct 'rss' feed URL OR an 'appleId' (the number in an Apple Podcasts URL, e.g. 1650340709). The server resolves Apple IDs to their RSS feed.
_how_to_add.article: type: 'article'. Give a direct 'rss' URL. Most news sites and every Substack has one (Substack = the site URL + /feed).
